packages.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools — scope and status QA
facts: DESNZ's UK ETS technical guidance collection provides compliance guidance, emission factors and reporting templates for installations and aircraft operators.
The collection lists a 24 July 2026 country-specific factor list using UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory data for annual emissions reporting in 2026.
The collection lists the revised UK ETS Waste quarterly data report template for quarter 2 dated 26 June 2026.
UK ETS default factors and reporting templates support scheme reporting and do not by themselves constitute measured emissions for an individual cadastral parcel.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from the UK ETS guidance collection.

packages.title: UK ETS reports and scheme reviews — scope and status QA
facts: The UK ETS reports and scheme reviews collection contains scheme, compliance and market-functioning reporting from the UK ETS Authority.
The collection includes allocation tables, hospitals and small emitters information, ultra-small emitter information, scheme reviews and public Registry reports.
Scheme reports and allowance records must remain distinct from direct physical greenhouse-gas measurements.
Facility or operator reporting under the UK ETS does not establish emissions for the cadastral parcel containing a facility.
No parcel emissions value is inferred from UK ETS reporting collections.

packages.title: UK ETS Public Reports — scope and status QA
facts: The UK ETS Public Reports service publishes public information derived from the UK ETS Registry.
The service lists installation-operator account holder and free-allocation reports for 2026 and earlier years, with files shown as published on 5 July 2026.
Registry account-holder and allowance-allocation data are compliance and market records rather than direct parcel emission measurements.
Year and report type must be preserved when using UK ETS Registry public reports.
No cadastral parcel emission value is inferred from Registry account or allocation data.

packages.title: Participating in the UK ETS — detailed guidance — scope and status QA
facts: Detailed UK ETS participation guidance requires installations and aircraft operators to submit verified emissions reports for the previous scheme year and surrender sufficient allowances.
Domestic maritime emissions entered the UK ETS from 1 July 2026, with offshore vessels scheduled from 1 January 2027.
Maritime operators have separate onboarding and monitoring obligations under the scheme.
Verified scheme reporting is operator-level compliance evidence and is not automatically parcel-level measurement.
No cadastral parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from scheme participation rules.

packages.title: Taking part in the UK ETS markets — scope and status QA
facts: The UK ETS markets guidance was last updated on 10 July 2026.
The 10 July update refreshed Cost Containment Mechanism figures for the latest month.
The page notes that a revised 2026 auction calendar was published by ICE on 1 July 2026 to reflect maritime inclusion.
Auction calendars, allowance prices and market mechanisms are market data and must not be treated as physical greenhouse-gas measurements.
